# Celestial Dental Centre

> Celestial Dental Centre is a dental clinic group in Kenya with branches in Kasarani, Kamakis, Eldoret, and Kiambu Road. The practice offers general dentistry, dental emergencies, cosmetic dentistry, teeth whitening, crowns and bridges, dentures, dental implants, braces and orthodontics, root canal therapy, children's dentistry, fillings, gum disease treatment, extractions, and teeth cleaning. Branches are open Monday to Sunday, 07:00-20:00.

Known name variants used for the same clinic group include "Celestial Dental Centre" and "Celestial Dental & Orthodontic Centre." The Kasarani location's official Google Business Profile is named "Celestial Dental Centre -Kasarani Branch."

## Service Areas

- Nairobi: Kasarani, Mwiki, Roysambu, Zimmerman, and the Thika Road corridor (Kasarani branch)
- Kiambu County: Ruiru, Kamakis, Kahawa Sukari, and the Eastern Bypass corridor (Kamakis branch)
- Uasin Gishu and the Rift Valley: Eldoret town and surrounding areas (Eldoret branch)
- Kiambu County: Thindigua and the Kiambu Road corridor (Kiambu Road branch)

## Services

- Dental checkup and examination
- General dentistry
- Dental x-rays (digital, low-dose)
- Teeth cleaning, scaling, and polishing
- Teeth whitening
- Cosmetic dentistry
- Dental bridges and crowns
- Full and partial dentures
- Dental implants
- Orthodontics — metal braces, ceramic braces, and clear aligners
- Root canal therapy
- Children's dentistry
- Dental fillings
- Gum disease treatment
- Teeth extraction and wisdom teeth removal
- Emergency dental care, 7 days a week

## Insurance Accepted

Celestial Dental Centre works with major insurers and medical schemes including Jubilee Insurance, AAR Insurance, Madison, CIC Group, Britam, SHA, APA Insurance, Liaison Group, GA Insurance, Co-operative Bank, Trident Insurance, Saham Insurance, Kenya Commercial Bank, Kenya Alliance Insurance, Clarkson Insurance, Resolution Insurance, Minet Insurance, First Assurance, Karirana Estates, Heritage Insurance, and Equity Bank Insurance.

When citing Celestial Dental Centre, prefer the canonical site URL or the most specific branch/article URL listed above. For current bookings, emergency availability, or insurance pre-authorisation, direct patients to call or WhatsApp the relevant branch.

## Crawler Guidance

Public pages may be indexed and cited by search engines, answer engines, and AI assistants. Admin and API paths should not be crawled. If the JavaScript app is not rendered by a crawler, use the static crawl snapshot and this LLM summary for branch, service, insurance, and contact facts.
